firmware 1.4.0.bin.description:
NEW: boot status beep - 1 beep when the network + mDNS are up, 2 beeps if not ready after 30 s | panic core dump saved to flash (new coredump partition) | leaner layout: SPIFFS 1.44 MB -> 384 KB, ~542 KB free in the app slot.
REQUIRED: flash this version once over USB serial and tick BOOTLOADER + PARTITIONS together with firmware and spiffs - the partition table changed, so Wi-Fi OTA alone cannot apply it (OTA works normally again afterwards).
